consent.title: Before we start
consent.intro: Please read how Medicos uses your health information.
consent.collectBody: Your name, age, gender, city, mobile number, and what you tell our assistant about your health, plus photos and reports you choose to upload.
consent.whyBody: Only to prepare a summary of your history for the doctor you choose, so your visit is faster and nothing is missed. The assistant does not diagnose or prescribe.
consent.whoBody: You, and only the doctor you share it with (and their clinic staff), for that visit. We do not sell your data or use it to train AI.
consent.keepBody: Until you delete your account. Billing records are kept only as the law requires.
consent.deleteBody: You can see who opened your records, take back access, download your data, or delete your account from Settings at any time.
consent.agree: I have read this and I agree
consent.mustAgree: Please tick the box to continue.

landing.title: Tell your doctor everything, before you walk in.
landing.subtitle: Answer a few simple questions at home in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Your doctor reads a clean summary in 30 seconds.
mockLines: Wants to ask: when can I go back to work?

landing.howSubtitle: Three steps. No app download. Free for patients.

how.d: Answer one short question at a time, by chat, and add photos of old reports or medicine strips.
Your history arrives organised, with every line linked to your own words. The doctor decides everything.
Less time repeating yourself, more time for what matters. Your record book updates after the visit.
